## Project team

**Josiah Parry** is a Sr. Product Engineer in Spatial Statistics as Esri where he creates and maintains the R-ArcGIS Bridge. He is also a maintainer of the extendr project for creating Rust-powered R packages.

This proposal is done independently of my affiliation with Esri.
